questionResults.question: What species has the longest wingspan
questionResults.sql:
SELECT `common name`, `scientific name`, `avg_Wingspan` 
FROM `Species` 
ORDER BY `avg_Wingspan` DESC 
LIMIT 1;
questionResults.friendlyResponse: The Wandering Albatross has the longest wingspan.

questionResults.question: What species has the longest wingspan and what do they eat
questionResults.sql:
SELECT `common name`, `diet`
FROM `Species`
ORDER BY `avg_Wingspan` DESC
LIMIT 1;
questionResults.friendlyResponse: The species with the longest wingspan is the Wandering Albatross, and they primarily eat squid and fish.

questionResults.question: What bird was seen last
questionResults.sql:
SELECT B.Name
FROM `Bird` B
JOIN `Bird Sighting` BS ON B.id = BS.bird_id
ORDER BY `Sighting date` DESC
LIMIT 1;
questionResults.friendlyResponse: Athena was the last bird seen.

questionResults.question: what day are more birds seen on
questionResults.sql:
SELECT `Sighting date`, COUNT(*) AS bird_count
FROM `Bird Sighting`
GROUP BY `Sighting date`
ORDER BY bird_count DESC
LIMIT 1;
questionResults.friendlyResponse: More birds are seen on August 22, 2026.
